(−3+4i)(1−2i) = −3 + 6i + 4i − 8i² = 5 + 10i

The denominator is (1+2i)(1−2i) = 5, so the quotient is (5+10i)/5 = 1 + 2i.

Check: (1+2i)(1+2i) = 1 + 4i − 4 = −3 + 4i, which matches the original numerator.
